spec.scene: A polished dark wood windowsill forms the ground. At the center sits a ceramic mug of warm tea, slightly oversized. To the left, a small round lamp glows with gentle amber light. To the right, a leafy potted green houseplant rests quietly. Along the back edge, a clean windowpane reflects the soft interior light against the dark night outside.
spec.title: A Quiet Night
spec.caption: A calm, still evening to rest and recharge.
